Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside, especially when it rained. One day, she put on her bathing suit and went outside to play.

As she was playing, her dress got very dirty. She could not find her favorite coat, a shiny scarf, and a scarf. She looked under the sun and saw her friend Tom. Tom was sad but he was not being careful.
